title: Crypto Token Risk Checker
description: Paste one or more Solana mint or Base (ERC-20) token addresses. Each token is checked for rug risk (SAFE / CAUTION / DANGER). Optionally add whale flow and a pre-trade pack.

tokens.title: Token addresses
tokens.description: Solana mint addresses (base58) and/or Base ERC-20 contract addresses (0x…). Chain is auto-detected from the address format. Prefill examples: BONK on Solana and USDC on Base.

includeWhaleFlow.title: Include whale flow
includeWhaleFlow.description: Also fetch large DEX buys and sells, net flow and an accumulation / distribution signal for each token. Adds $0.02 per token that returns a successful whale-flow result.

includePreTradePack.title: Include pre-trade pack
includePreTradePack.description: Also return a GO / CAUTION / STOP pre-trade decision that combines the token verdict with an OFAC screen of the token's authorities and, if you provide a wallet, that wallet's USDC pay-readiness. Adds $0.015 per token that returns a successful pack.

hours.title: Whale-flow window (hours)
hours.description: Lookback window for whale flow, from 1 to 24 hours. Ignored unless Include whale flow is on.

minUsd.title: Minimum whale trade (USD)
minUsd.description: Optional minimum DEX trade size in USD (50–1,000,000). Leave empty to use the API default. Ignored unless Include whale flow is on.

wallet.title: Counterparty wallet
wallet.description: Optional Base or Solana wallet to include in the pre-trade pack (OFAC screen + USDC pay-readiness). Ignored unless Include pre-trade pack is on.

amount.title: USDC amount to pay
amount.description: USDC amount the wallet should be able to pay (used with Counterparty wallet). Default 1. Ignored unless Include pre-trade pack is on and a wallet is set.
